dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Not going back to the Guild yet?

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: Taisuke's been really taken with that talking cat named Neko. He insists that we continue investigating for a while.

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: I'm just here to make sure that he doesn't do anything idiotic in the process.

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: And I'm also taking this opportunity to slack off for a bit.
